title: 第3章  夺天地阴阳，享无上造化
slug: 我一杂役怎么成掌门孩子他爹了
content_zh:
“你……你说什么？”
柳嫣然顿时呆了一呆，一脸不可置信地望着叶长天。
她甚至有些怀疑自己耳朵出问题了。
这家伙竟然同意退婚了？
他不应该像往常一样，拿出自己辛苦赚的灵石，然后跪下来哭着求她不要退婚么？
“我说退婚可以，还我一万灵石就行，你听不懂人话？”
叶长天冷冷地道：“少特么废话，自己交出灵石然后滚蛋，你跟老子在床上修炼的三十六式绝技，我都用留影石记录了的，你也不想你的圣子哥哥知道吧？”
“叶长天，你……你无耻！”
柳嫣然气得浑身颤抖。
她怎么也没想到，叶长天不仅同意退婚，而且还将那种事情用留影石记录了下来，以此来威胁她！
柳嫣然眼眸中杀意涌动。
既然如此，那就别怪她不念昔日旧情了。
反正叶长天现在也只是一个无足轻重的杂役弟子，宗门又有谁会在意一位杂役弟子的死活？
“老子就是这么无耻，你不服？”
叶长天仿佛像是看穿了柳嫣然的想法，淡淡地道：“你也别想着杀了我就万事大吉，留影石如今不在我这里，你若敢动我，我保证明天整个太玄宗都会见识到你在床上的风采。”
“你……”
柳嫣然又羞又怒，却也只能将心中的杀意按捺下来。
她不敢赌！
要是真如叶长天所言，一旦她杀了叶长天，不仅与圣子哥哥的婚事要黄，她以后甚至都没脸在太玄宗见人了。
柳嫣然绝对不允许这样的事情发生。

“叶长天，你以为我稀罕你那几个臭灵石，一万灵石还给你，你若敢将我们之间的事情透露半个字，我一定会让你知道什么叫做后悔！”
柳嫣然望向叶长天的目光快要喷出火来，啪地将一个袋子砸在叶长天的面前。
看着径直朝自己关键部位砸来的灵石袋子，叶长天下意识地闪避，然后某个地方就碰到了夏秋水的嘴唇，令得夏秋水忍不住发出了一阵声音。
“嗯？”
叶长天的被子里，竟然还有女人的声音？
柳嫣然先是愣了一愣，旋即很快反应过来。
她面色铁青地盯着叶长天：“我就说你今天怎么转性了，原来你早就背着我跟其他女人勾搭在一起了！”
“怎么，就允许你跟你的圣子哥哥勾搭在一起，我就不能找其他女人了？”
叶长天冷笑不已道：“更何况我们已经解除婚约，老子的事情你管得着吗？”
“好，很好！”
柳嫣然冷冷地说了一句，转身就要离开。
“等一下。”
就在这时，叶长天突然叫住了她。
柳嫣然还以为叶长天后悔了，不由回头望着叶长天，嘴角掀起一抹冷笑：“怎么，叶长天，你不会现在又后悔了，想要跪下来哭着求我不要退婚吧？”
“柳嫣然，你要是没睡醒，我可以用尿把你滋醒。”
“既然都已经退婚，把玄灵宝珠也还给我吧，现在你已经不配拥有它了。”
叶长天对着柳嫣然伸出了手掌。
玄灵宝珠！
这可是父亲侥幸得到的一件宝物。
虽说这东西只是个残品，而且连品级都不知道，可戴在身上却能大大提升修行速度。

原主那个傻逼在柳嫣然的忽悠下，竟然将这等宝物都送了出去。
“叶长天，我当初可是用第一次跟你换的玄灵宝珠，你竟然还好意思把玄灵宝珠要回去？”
柳嫣然肺都差点气炸了。
她修行天赋并不算出色，能在短短三年时间筑基成功，成为太玄宗内门弟子，主要就是因为玄灵宝珠能够大大提升修行速度。
这等宝物，柳嫣然又怎会心甘情愿还给叶长天？
“我将玄灵宝珠给你使用，并没有将玄灵宝珠送给你，既然都退婚了，我为什么不能要回来？”
叶长天面无表情：“只是跟我睡了几次，就换取了玄灵宝珠三年的使用权，你已经赚了。废话少说，交出玄灵珠宝然后有多远滚多远！”
“你……”
柳嫣然双拳握得咯吱作响，差点没有当场暴走。
不过想到自己还有把柄在叶长天的手中，最终只能将满腔怒火压了下来。
她抬手一挥，将一颗约么鸡蛋大小、通体晶莹剔透的珠子直接丢在了叶长天的面前，然后头也不回地转身离开了。
走出房间。
一股再也难以掩饰的杀意，瞬间从柳嫣然的眼眸中弥漫开来。
“叶长天，这是你逼我的！”
玄灵宝珠对她修行至关重要，将玄灵宝珠还给叶长天只是权宜之计。
待她想办法解决掉留影石的事情，到时候定要杀了叶长天，将玄灵宝珠夺回来！
柳嫣然离开后。
夏秋水也是咻地从被子里闪掠而出，一把长剑再次鬼魅般地架在了叶长天的脖子上：
“叶长天，你想找死吗？”
“掌……掌门息怒，刚才只是一个意外。”

叶长天连忙大声叫了起来。
夏秋水想到刚才的事情，就气不打一处来。
要不是这家伙将她拉进被子里，她早就瞬移离开了，又怎会差点被人抓奸在床？
最可恶的是。
这家伙差点将那玩意戳进她嘴里！
简直可恶！
不过——
想到昨晚的事情，感受到自己已有突破迹象的修为，夏秋水这才强压下了心头的杀意。
夏秋水冷冷地说了一句，身形一闪就鬼魅般地消失在叶长天的面前。
“呼——”
望着夏秋水消失的地方，叶长天终于忍不住长长地舒了口气。
他的小命总算是暂时保住了。
不过想要睡服这位绝色掌门，依旧任重而道远啊。
摇了摇头。
叶长天沉下心来，仔细地感应着脑海中的阴阳造化诀。
他穿越过来后，阴阳造化诀这本书就莫名其妙出现在了脑海里。
这阴阳造化诀能够让他这个伪灵根的废材，通过与夏秋水双修瞬间提升好几个境界，绝非什么寻常之物。
叶长天打算好好研究一下。
“嗡！”
就在叶长天将注意力集中在阴阳造化诀上的时候，他意识瞬间穿透了阴阳造化诀的表面，进入一片神秘的世界。

与此同时。
一道信息出现在了叶长天的脑海：
阴阳造化界，夺天地阴阳，享无上造化！
content_en:
"You...what did you say?"
Liu Yanran was stunned for a moment, looking at Ye Changtian in disbelief.
She even suspected that there was something wrong with her ears.
This guy actually agreed to break off the engagement?
Shouldn't he, as usual, take out his hard-earned spiritual stones, kneel down and cry, begging her not to break off the engagement?
"I said it's okay to break off the engagement and give me back 10,000 spiritual stones. Can't you understand human language?"
Ye Changtian said coldly: "What nonsense are you talking about? Hand over the spirit stone and get out of here. I recorded all the thirty-six stunts you and I practiced on the bed with the photo stone. You don't want your Holy Son brother to know about it, right?"
"Ye Changtian, you...you are shameless!"
Liu Yanran was so angry that her whole body trembled.
She never expected that Ye Changtian not only agreed to break off the engagement, but also recorded the incident with a photo stone to threaten her!
Liu Yanran's eyes were filled with murderous intent.
In this case, don't blame her for not thinking about the old relationship.
Anyway, Ye Changtian is just an insignificant handyman disciple now. Who in the sect would care about the life and death of a handyman disciple?
"I'm so shameless, don't you agree?"
Ye Changtian seemed to have seen through Liu Yanran's thoughts and said calmly: "Don't think that everything will be fine if you kill me. The photo stone is not with me now. If you dare to touch me, I guarantee that the entire Taixuan Sect will see your grace in bed tomorrow."
"You..."
Liu Yanran was ashamed and angry, but she could only suppress the murderous intention in her heart.
She doesn't dare to gamble!
If it is true as Ye Changtian said, once she kills Ye Changtian, not only will her marriage with Brother Shengzi be ruined, but she will not even have the face to see anyone in Taixuan Sect in the future.
Liu Yanran would never allow such a thing to happen.
"Ye Changtian, you think I care about your few stinky spirit stones. I will give you back ten thousand spirit stones. If you dare to reveal even a word about what happened between us, I will definitely let you know what regret is!"
Liu Yanran looked at Ye Changtian with eyes that were about to burst into flames, and slammed a bag in front of Ye Changtian.
Seeing the bag of spirit stones hitting his key parts, Ye Changtian subconsciously dodged, and then he touched Xia Qiu Shui's lips somewhere, causing Xia Qiu Shui to make a sound.
"Huh?"
There was actually a woman's voice in Ye Changtian's quilt?
Liu Yanran was stunned for a moment, then quickly realized what she was doing.
She stared at Ye Changtian with a livid face: "I asked you why you changed your gender today. It turns out that you have been hooking up with other women behind my back!"
"Why, you are allowed to hook up with your brother Shengzi, but I can't find other women?"
Ye Changtian sneered and said: "What's more, we have terminated our engagement. Can you take care of my affairs?"
"Okay, good!"
Liu Yanran said coldly, turned around and left.
"Wait a minute."
At this moment, Ye Changtian suddenly stopped her.
Liu Yanran thought Ye Changtian regretted it, so she couldn't help but look back at Ye Changtian, with a sneer on her lips: "Why, Ye Changtian, you don't regret it again now, and want to kneel down and cry and beg me not to break off the engagement, do you?"
"Liu Yanran, if you don't wake up, I can use urine to wake you up."
"Since the engagement has been broken off, please return the Xuanling Orb to me. You no longer deserve it."
Ye Changtian stretched out his palm towards Liu Yanran.
Xuanling Orb!
This is a treasure that my father got by chance.
Although this thing is just a broken product, and the grade is not even known, wearing it can greatly increase the speed of practice.
The original owner, the idiot, gave away all these treasures under Liu Yanran's deception.
"Ye Changtian, I used the Xuanling Orb that I exchanged with you for the first time, and you actually have the nerve to take the Xuanling Orb back?"
Liu Yanran's lungs almost exploded with anger.
Her cultivation talent is not outstanding, but she can do it in a short timeIn just three years, he succeeded in building a foundation and became an inner disciple of Taixuan Sect, mainly because the Xuanling Orb can greatly increase the speed of practice.
How could Liu Yanran willingly return such a treasure to Ye Changtian?
"I gave the Xuanling Orb to you, but I didn't give it to you. Since the engagement has been broken off, why can't I get it back?"
Ye Changtian's face was expressionless: "You just slept with me a few times in exchange for the right to use the Xuanling Jewel for three years. You have already earned it. Stop talking nonsense, hand over the Xuanling Jewel and get away as far as you want!"
"You..."
Liu Yanran clenched her fists so hard that she almost ran away on the spot.
However, thinking that he still had the leverage in Ye Changtian's hands, he could only suppress his anger in the end.
She raised her hand and threw a crystal-clear bead about the size of an egg directly in front of Ye Changtian, then turned and left without looking back.
Walk out of the room.
A killing intent that could no longer be concealed instantly filled Liu Yanran's eyes.
"Ye Changtian, you forced me to do this!"
The Xuanling Orb is crucial to her practice, and returning the Xuanling Orb to Ye Changtian is just a temporary measure.
When she finds a way to solve the problem of the Shadow Stone, she will definitely kill Ye Changtian and take back the Xuanling Orb!
After Liu Yanran left.
Xia Qiushui also swooped out of the quilt, and a long sword was placed on Ye Changtian's neck like a ghost again:
"Ye Changtian, do you want to die?"
"Master...master, calm down, it was just an accident."
Ye Changtian quickly shouted loudly.
Xia Qiushui became very angry when she thought about what happened just now.
If this guy hadn't pulled her into the quilt, she would have teleported away long ago. How could she have been almost caught and raped in bed?
The most damning thing is.
This guy almost stuck that thing in her mouth!
Absolutely abominable!
But——
Thinking of what happened last night and feeling that his cultivation had shown signs of breakthrough, Xia Qiushui suppressed the murderous intention in his heart.
Xia Qiushui said coldly, and disappeared in front of Ye Changtian like a ghost in a flash.
"Huh——"
Looking at the place where Xia Qiushui disappeared, Ye Changtian couldn't help but let out a long sigh of relief.
His life was finally saved temporarily.
However, there is still a long way to go to sleep with this stunning leader.
Shaked his head.
Ye Changtian calmed down and carefully sensed the Yin and Yang Creation Technique in his mind.
After he traveled through time, the book Yin Yang Creation Technique appeared in his mind inexplicably.
This Yin-Yang Creation Technique can allow him, a waste with pseudo-spiritual roots, to instantly rise to several realms through dual cultivation with Xia Qiushui. It is definitely not an ordinary thing.
Ye Changtian planned to study it carefully.
"Buzz!"
Just when Ye Changtian focused his attention on the Yin-Yang Creation Art, his consciousness instantly penetrated the surface of the Yin-Yang Creation Art and entered a mysterious world.
at the same time.
A message appeared in Ye Changtian's mind:
In the world of yin and yang creation, seize the yin and yang of heaven and earth, and enjoy supreme creation!
